id.description: A ULID: product or category ID.

line.description: One line of text: no line breaks or other control characters.

link.description: Where a button goes: a path on the store (/p/shirt), a section of the page (#s-newest) or an https URL (https://wa.me/...). Nothing else, so no javascript: or data: links.

title.description: A section heading; empty uses the default in the shopper's language.
